critical_code_review_comments: analytics_routes.py L162-175: there is an unreachable fallback branch — `if not per_cat and all_quotes` re-fetches jobs with category projection, but the initial jobs_map was loaded with only {posted_at:1}, so the FIRST per_cat aggregation pass will always see job.get('category') == None and per_cat stays empty. Result: category_conversion will only ever be populated by the fallback re-fetch path. Suggest fixing initial projection to include 'category' OR removing the dead first pass.

analytics_routes.py L194: peak_hours filter uses `country: user.get('country', '')` (empty string fallback). If user has no country set, this matches jobs with empty-string country — could return misleading data. Consider skipping the filter entirely when user.country is missing.

AdvancedAnalytics.jsx L22: fetches /api/analytics/pro-insights even when the result will render the locked upgrade card. Wasted call for Standard pros — consider gating with plan_tier from /auth/me cache, or have backend return tiny payload when plan_tier='standard'.
